description.value: Rolling Pin Bakery is a neighbourhood bakery in Hope, BC, specializing in freshly made donuts (30+ flavours), buttery pastries, artisan breads, sausage rolls, and custom cakes. What began as a single Hope location has grown to include a second Fraser Valley spot in Rosedale, opened in October 2025. Cyclists riding through the Fraser Valley corridor will find it a welcoming stop for quick, calorie-dense baked treats made fresh daily.
